title: Unadmitted observation builders: enforce the routing_token shape before sending
outcome: engram_unadmitted_turn_request and engram_observed_check_request (src/engram_unadmitted_observation.rs) refuse a routing_token that is blank, untrimmed or over 128 bytes, as Engram's execution_observe contract requires (behavioral-control-plane.md:886), instead of failing at the producer.
acceptance: Both builders refuse a blank, a padded and a 129-byte routing_token and accept a 128-byte one; unit tests show each.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
